description: Time zone at a location — IANA time zone for a lat/lon (or place=) with the current local time, UTC offset, abbreviation, whether DST is observed/active, standard and daylight offsets, and the exact next DST transition in UTC. at= (ISO date-time or epoch seconds) evaluates another instant. Exact IANA zone for US locations (NWS points service, incl. AK/HI/PR/Guam); elsewhere returns the nautical UTC offset from longitude, flagged approximate. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: geo_timezone
